blocks.title: Condensation polymerisation
blocks.text: Condensation polymerisation mein monomers aapas mein jurte hain aur har naya bond bante waqt aik chhota molecule nikalta hai, aam taur par paani lekin kabhi HCl, CH3OH ya NH3. Monomers mein kam az kam do reactive functional groups (jaise -OH, -COOH ya -NH2) hone chahiye, monomer(s) ke mukhtalif siron par, aur polymer qadam ba qadam barhta hai.

blocks.alt: Condensation polymerisation: monomers H-X-H aur HO-Y-OH, 'do qism ke monomers'. Yeh H-X-[H+HO]-Y-[OH+H]-X-[H+HO]-Y-OH ki tarah qataar mein aate hain, har jor ke H aur OH dashed dabbon mein. Peela teer 'Condensation reaction' H-X-Y-X-Y-OH + 3H2O tak le jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 26.3: Condensation polymerisation ki wazahat (kitab ki Figure 26.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Polyesters ki reerh mein ester links (-CO-O-) hote hain. Aik diol (do -OH groups) aur aik dicarboxylic acid (do -COOH groups) mil kar polyester banate hain: diol ka -OH tezaab ke -COOH se react karta aur paani nikalta hai. Terylene (PET) ethane-1,2-diol aur benzene-1,4-dicarboxylic acid se banta hai.

blocks.alt: Monomers: HOCH2CH2OH (ethane-1,2-diol) aur HOOC-C6H4-COOH (benzene-1,4-dicarboxylic acid). Polymerisation: ...+ HOCH2CH2OH HOOC-C6H4-COOH HOCH2CH2OH HOOC-C6H4-COOH +..., diol ke OH ka H aur tezaab ka OH magenta rang mein. Teer se ...OCH2CH2OOC-C6H4-COOCH2CH2OOC-C6H4-CO-..., aur chaaron ester links ke neeche + H2O.
blocks.caption: Terylene/PET ki tayyari, ethane-1,2-diol aur benzene-1,4-dicarboxylic acid se polyester (kitab ke PDF safha 148 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Diol ke har -OH ka H aur tezaab ke har -COOH ka OH (magenta) mil kar paani (H2O) bante hain. Jahan yeh nikalte hain wahan -CO-O- ester link (jor) banta hai. Zanjeer ka dohrane wala hissa (repeat unit) -OCH2CH2O-CO-C6H4-CO- hai: aik diol aur aik tezaab.

Polyesters ki tanao ki taqat zyada hai, jo inhein reshon ke liye munasib banati hai; polyester kam qeemat aur silwat na parne ki wajah se cotton ke mutabadil ke taur par use hota hai. Yeh plastic ke taur par bhi use hota hai, maslan mashroobat aur khurak ki packaging ki PET (PETE) botlein, aur sakht plastics mein cross-links ke taur par, jaise glass fibre se mazboot cross-linked polyester.

items: Diamine aur dicarboxylic acid se: diamine ka -NH2 tezaab ke -COOH se react karta aur paani nikalta hai: n H2N-R-NH2 + n HOOC-R'-COOH -> [-HN-R-NH-CO-R'-CO-]n + 2n H2O. Nylon-6,6 hexane-1,6-diamine (hexamethylenediamine) aur hexanedioic (adipic) acid use karta hai.
Diamine aur dioyl chloride (do -COCl groups) se, jo dicarboxylic acids se zyada reactive hain; hydrogen chloride nikalta hai: n H2N-R-NH2 + n ClOC-R'-COCl -> [-HN-R-NH-CO-R'-CO-]n + 2n HCl.

Amino acid se, aik hi monomer jis mein -NH2 aur -COOH dono: aik molecule ka -NH2 doosre ke -COOH se react kar ke paani nikalta aur peptide bond, aik qism ka amide link, banata hai: n H2N-CH2-COOH -> [-HN-CH2-CO-]n + n H2O. Proteins amino acids se bane qudrati polyamides hain (Chapter 27).

blocks.alt: nH2N-CH2-NH2 (diamine) + nHOOC-CH2-COOH (dicarboxylic acid) se [-HN-CH2-NH-C(=O)-CH2-C(=O)-]n (polyamide) + 2nH2O; har C=O mein O, C ke oopar.
blocks.caption: Diamine aur dicarboxylic acid se polyamide (kitab ke PDF safha 149 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka; paani 2nH2O likha gaya).
Diamine aur dioyl chloride se polyamide (kitab ke PDF safha 149 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka; HCl 2nHCl likha gaya).
Amino acid se polyamide (polypeptide) (kitab ke PDF safha 149 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab in dono mua'adlon mein '+ nH2O' aur '+ nHCl' likhti hai. Lekin har repeat unit mein do amide links (jor) hain, aur har jor par aik chhota molecule nikalta hai. Is liye n diamine aur n diacid (ya dioyl chloride) se 2n H2O (ya 2n HCl) nikalte hain; hum ne sahih 2n likha hai. (Amino acid wale mua'adle mein har unit mein aik hi jor hai, is liye wahan nH2O sahih hai.) Kitab asaani ke liye monomers mein darmiyan sirf CH2 likhti hai; asal misalon mein lambi zanjeerein hoti hain, jaise nylon-6,6 mein (CH2)6 aur (CH2)4.

Amide links acyl chloride aur ammonia ya amine (jaise methanamine, CH3NH2, ya N-methylmethanamine, (CH3)2NH) ke darmiyan bhi, hydrogen chloride kho kar, bante hain: R-COCl + R'-NH2 -> R-CO-NH-R' + HCl. Yeh kamre ke darja hararat par aasani se hota hai kyunke acyl chlorides bohat reactive hain.

blocks.alt: R-C(=O)-Cl (acyl chloride) + R'-NH2 (amine) se R-C(=O)-NH-R' (amide) + HCl (hydrogen chloride).
blocks.caption: Acyl chloride aur amine se amide (kitab ke PDF safha 149 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Diamine aur dioyl chloride ke reaction mein kaun sa chhota molecule nikalta hai, aur dioyl chloride kyun use hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Hydrogen chloride; dioyl chlorides dicarboxylic acids se kaheen zyada reactive hain, is liye reaction kamre ke darje par aasani se hota hai.

items: Condensation: har jor par chhota molecule (H2O, HCl) nikalta; monomers ko do reactive groups chahiye.
Polyamides (-CONH-): diamine + diacid ya dioyl chloride, ya amino acids.
